title: Japanese Chickpea Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired stir-fry made with chickpeas and a variety of vegetables.

ingredients.name: fluffy
ingredients.amount: 2 cups mixed vegetables (e.g. bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, soy sauce, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
